terms.definition: The device Camera2 HAL reports this capability as supported in its characteristics or stream maps.
Point and Shoot parity sweep successfully exercised this capability on a real device session.
A capture session could be created that includes this capability without immediate failure.
Percentage of HAL-advertised catalog cells that were proven in the parity sweep.
OEM score for how much advertised hardware is gated from third-party Camera2 apps. Higher means more restrictive.
Combined physical sensor area of rear non-logical cameras from HAL or GSMArena.
Android standard camera API used by third-party apps, not the OEM proprietary camera app.
Android SDK/API level running on the device during the parity sweep.
Maintainer USB sweep published from the project regression fleet.
User-submitted Full parity sweep that passed automated validation.
Marketing spec-sheet data from GSMArena. Not verified by Point and Shoot Camera2 sweeps.
USB Full parity sweep on stock ROM. Separate from GSMArena advertised specs.
0-100 score for rear cameras with higher MP on alternate HAL stream maps vs Camera2 default path.
Weighted sum of proven catalog features, resolutions, and capability gates. Primary capability rank.
